text: Debugging is an important skill for any programmer. When your code does not work as expected, the first step is identifying bugs. This means finding out where and why the problem happens. Many developers use debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, to pause the program and check values. A systematic approach is also helpful: test one part at a time, make small changes, and check the results carefully. Logging is another useful method. By adding log messages to your code, you can see what the program is doing and find errors more easily. With practice, debugging becomes faster and less stressful.
